basic_info.description: This has to be one of the most elite homes on the North Side of our beautiful city, San Francisco.   It is situated on an extra wide lot (over 35 feet wide) which makes a huge difference in the scale of every room in this house.   What makes this location so unique is the fact that this part of the Strawberry Point and it is not on fill.   Yes!  Not on Fill.   This gorgeous Santa Barbara-style home has been completely elevated to the highest standard.  It is truly move-in with a wonderful East Coast vibe.   Aside from its unique location of views but extremely quiet, the interior of the home features one of the grandest kitchens in all of San Francisco.   No expense was spared here with all  top-of-the-line appliances, fixtures and lighting.  There is a grand Living Room that is both sophisticated and stunning.  On the top floor, there are three bedrooms including the Primary Suite.  The primary features panoramic views of the Bay and a warm gas fireplace on demand.  It also has arguably one of the best " hers" closets you will ever see.  The bottom level features a Lounge or Theater room with 2 guest suites, one of which can be the perfect office with its own entrance.  There is a large garage and 2 car parking, wine closet, dog wash station and guest parking out front.
